description: This file contains C functions related to memory management, specifically functions that free pointers and set them to NULL, and conditionally free pointers if they are non-NULL.

methods.name: int use_FREE_AND_NULL(int * v)
methods.description: Frees the memory pointed to by the pointer and sets it to NULL.

methods.name: int need_no_if(int * v)
methods.description: Intended to free the pointer if it is non-NULL, but contains a bug where it calls free on the pointer itself instead of dereferenced pointer.
